title: Hydrate Shallow Kit Designs And Richest Mcp Design Payload
description: Shallow kit lists designs without pieces; load sibling *.design.compose.json by guid. UI: merge richest design from MCP candidates and score by piece count.
summary: Engine: _hydrate_design_from_kit_disk_if_shallow loads sibling *.design.compose.json when session design has no pieces; when multiple files share the same guid (e.g. meta vs shallow), pick the one with the most pieces. _get_session_design replaces session with hydrated dict. UI: mcpDesignRichness + mergeRichestDesignFromCandidates + score weights so full design wins over truncated structuredContent. Tests: engine shallow-kit Nakagin, vitest merge. Rebuilt dist/mcp-app.html.
